messages:
devon: Hey — can someone drop the shortlink for the service-overview + model-health dashboards for asia-pacific-east? I need to share with infra for a quick capacity check.
maya: pinging grafana, will grab shortlinks. do you need any particular time-range/filter? :wave:
devon: Just last 24h and the model='realtime-infer' filter would be great. also, i might get a permissions denied from a customer engineer, so a link that respects our role-based shortlink would help.
maya: http://grafana.internal/r/UZJk3m/service-overview?orgId=1&var-region=ap-east&from=-24h&to=now 
maya: http://grafana.internal/r/aP4sQ1/model-health?orgId=1&var-model=realtime-infer&from=-24h&to=now
li: heads up — those are team-private dashboards. if the person isn't in the infra-team group they'll get a 403. quick check: curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $GRAFANA_API_KEY" "https://grafana.internal/api/teams/search?name=infra-team" | jq .results
sam: i can add the customer engineer to the infra-team temporarily. devon, what's their github/email handle?
devon: rachel.corp (rachel.corp@customer.com) — she'll need view access only.
sam: ok i'll add them to the team for 2 hours and post here when done. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Alert: cpu_utilization of model-runtime-ap-east exceeded 80% (avg 15m) — alert #INC-7342 created by monitoring.
li: related — might want to mute the noisy pod-based alerts, threshold is a little low for peak traffic. propose bump to 85% for that alert group.
maya: +1 on raising to 85% for the high-burst model group. can someone file a small PR to alert-rules with the rationale?
sam: i'll open a PR and add the change to staging alerting for 24h, then roll to prod if no regressions.
devon: thanks all. sam — ping me when the infra invite goes out and i'll forward the shortlinks to rachel.
sam: invited rachel.corp@customer.com to infra-team (view role), expires in 2h. link should work now.
devon: confirmed rachel can view both dashboards. closing loop. thanks! :rocket:
